mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate over three months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced business investment, which lowers earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.0% and continues to decline for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) over two quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining GDP (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate over one month signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.50 percentage points in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rapid rate hikes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) over three months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over three months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the likelihood of aggressive Fed tightening and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of declining CPI (t-test p > 0.05).
